qs.s: Ma mère s'est fait un ___ pour retrouver un visage plus jeune.
qs.en: My mother had a facelift to get a younger-looking face.

qs.s: Le chirurgien lui a recommandé un ___ pour raffermir la peau du visage.
qs.en: The surgeon recommended a facelift to firm up the skin of her face.

qs.s: Le vieux cinéma du quartier a subi un ___ avant sa réouverture.
qs.en: The old neighborhood cinema underwent a makeover before its reopening.

qs.s: La chaîne de magasins a donné un ___ à son image pour séduire les jeunes clients.
qs.en: The store chain gave its image a makeover to appeal to young customers.

qs.s: Elle a décidé de s'offrir ___ lifting pour ses cinquante ans.
qs.en: She decided to treat herself to a facelift for her fiftieth birthday.

qs.en: Among lions, the male has an impressive mane while the female does not.

qs.en: The vet examined the kitten and confirmed it was a male, not a female.

qs.en: On his passport, the box indicates that he is of male sex.

qs.s: Le formulaire administratif demande si le nouveau-né est de sexe ___ ou femelle.
qs.en: The administrative form asks whether the newborn is of male or female sex.

qs.en: The researchers captured a male to study its behavior.

qs.en: During the war, each person received a ration of bread per day.

qs.s: Le soldat n'avait droit qu'à une ___ d'eau limitée dans le désert.
qs.en: The soldier was only entitled to a limited ration of water in the desert.

qs.s: Après cet examen difficile, il a eu sa ___ de stress.
qs.en: After this difficult exam, he had his share of stress.

qs.s: Cette semaine, elle a reçu sa ___ de mauvaises nouvelles.
qs.en: This week, she received her share of bad news.

qs.s: ___ ration de pain était insuffisante pour nourrir toute la famille.
qs.en: The ration of bread was insufficient to feed the whole family.

qs.s: Le médecin lui a prescrit ___ ration quotidienne de vitamines.
qs.en: The doctor prescribed him a daily ration of vitamins.
